about: The only things the companion repositories (STAIxBWLB/ahub-orca, ahub-herdr, ahub-claude) may assume about ahub. Removing or renaming a listed path, changing a listed closed set, an argv form, the exit code or the stderr prefix needs companion-cli-v2.json beside this file and a hub_task_handoff to each companion repository. Adding a field needs neither. test/companion-contract.test.ts holds ahub to it.

types.semver: string matching MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional -pre or +build suffix
types.count-map: object whose keys are in values and whose values are counts
types.prefixed: string equal to one of values or starting with one of prefixes

peers.<id>.attached.presence: when the peer has no adapter attached; absent otherwise

peers.<id>.pullOnly.presence: when the peer reads messages only through hub_inbox; absent otherwise

needs.first.presence: when any item needs the person; absent otherwise

needs.first.kind.presence: with needs.first; "approval" is a pending permission request

needs.first.until.presence: when the item expires (milliseconds since the epoch)

needs.first.peer.presence: when the item belongs to a peer

[].state.presence: always; readers recognise running and stopped, any other value reads as unknown
